contract.structural_score_basis: UPGRADED 4.0 to 5.0 on 2026-10-24. Both collateral oracles transferred owner() from the main Safe to the 72-hour timelock on October 5, Ethereum block 26126801. The deployer EOA lost EMERGENCY_ROLE on the WBTC pool on October 10, block 26158898. Archive boundary reads and current reads on two RPCs confirm both changes. Upgrades and owner-only oracle changes now wait 72 hours; the main 6-of-9 Safe and emergency 3-of-4 Safe retain undelayed EMERGENCY_ROLE on both pools and can call updatePriceOracle(address) without validation. This can alter position marks, liquidations and the redemption gate. A public matching audit for the later Ethereum PoolManager/pool/fxSP/PoolConfiguration rework remains unestablished. These residual risks cap Structural at 5.0.
